outcome: Composite adverse neonatal outcomes (defined as Apgar score < 7 at 5 min)
cohort: The study participants were 443 neonates born via complex cesarean sections to mothers with high suspicion of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) or confirmed uterine scar dehiscence, retrospectively analyzed from a single tertiary hospital.
finding: Preterm delivery and emergency delivery were identified as primary risk factors significantly associated with increased composite adverse neonatal outcomes in pregnancies complicated by high-risk Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS).
